limitations: Current-vintage Yahoo history can include vendor corrections; original unrevised historical publication vintages are not certified.
Split ledgers are checked mechanically for as-traded display-unit restoration, including later audit-only actions. They are not historical investment evidence.

Cash equities, indexes and rate proxies use independent exchange session calendars and actual scheduled close timestamps. Futures and DXY use latest bounded vendor observations; a separate official settlement tape was not acquired.
Crypto candles are independently checked as the prior UTC day completed at the report cutoff; these candles close exactly at midnight UTC.

Two Yahoo STOXX index histories lack August1 observations despite the XETR proxy calendar being open. These remain disclosed provider baseline gaps, not closure overrides; every applied1/5/20session horizon independently matches the calendar and begins no earlier than August2. ETHA starts with the retainedJuly23 series; no pre-inception prices are estimated.
